scope: Local ELN/LIMS foundation; an openBIS-style model, not a live openBIS installation or native API interchange guarantee.

standards.name: openBIS 7.x
standards.mapping: Space / Project / Collection / Object / Data set; project-defined type codes; Experimental step as an Object
standards.limits: Objects may belong to Space, Project or Collection; Data sets attach to Collection or Object. No native openBIS connector; no claim to implement all openBIS roles or mutable AFS storage.

standards.name: FAIR Guiding Principles
standards.mapping: Local UUIDs, authorized discovery, metadata, access conditions, rights, provenance and portable exports
standards.limits: No FAIR certification, repository preservation service, public metadata index or registered persistent identifiers. Restricted data can still follow FAIR access principles.

standards.name: W3C PROV-O
standards.mapping: Entity / Activity / Agent; used / wasGeneratedBy / wasDerivedFrom / wasAssociatedWith
standards.limits: Planned process outputs do not assert experimental generation. File ingestion generates extracted metadata, not original scientific observations.

standards.name: RO-Crate 1.3
standards.mapping: JSON-LD descriptor, root Dataset, file manifests, contextual entities and attached ZIP exports
standards.limits: Local structural and byte-integrity tests; no external conformance certification. Access restrictions and licenses remain explicit. Related research records are linked, not recursively packaged.

standards.name: DataCite Metadata Schema 4.7
standards.mapping: Draft titles, creators, identifiers, affiliations, resource types, related identifiers, rights and version
standards.limits: registration_ready=false; no invented DOI, publisher or publication year. Relations without a precise controlled equivalent use Other plus relationTypeInformation.

standards.name: UCUM / QUDT
standards.mapping: Explicit source units retained, recognized column units mapped to UCUM codes and selected QUDT unit URIs
standards.limits: No guessing of ambiguous C, unstated units, concentration-to-dose or mass-to-volume conversions.

standards.name: ORCID / ROR
standards.mapping: Creator and institution identifiers; ORCID checksum and ROR URI syntax validation
standards.limits: No registry identity, employment or affiliation verification.

standards.name: RDA PIDINST
standards.mapping: Installed asset name, owner, manufacturer, model and identifier fields; distinct model-catalog references
standards.limits: Local physical-asset record; no PID registration or validated PIDINST repository export. Serial numbers remain access-controlled.

local_vocabularies.type_codes: Project-defined record types; not universal ontology identifiers

privacy: Research payloads, R2 objects, runtime databases and private Purdue inventory are never GitHub seed data. Code and reviewed factual catalog updates are public.
